candidates.refactoringInfo: Move method setSystemProperties to class SysProperties
candidates.description:
Move method setSystemProperties to org.apache.tools.ant.types.CommandlineJava.SysProperties
Rationale: The method `setSystemProperties` directly invokes the `setSystem` method of the `SysProperties` class, which is responsible for managing system properties. The `SysProperties` class already contains functionality related to caching, modifying, and restoring system properties, making it the most logical and cohesive place for this method. Moving the method to `SysProperties` ensures that all system property-related operations are encapsulated within the same class, improving maintainability and reducing coupling between classes. Additionally, the `SysProperties` class has access to all the necessary internal data and helper methods, such as `mergePropertySets`, which are critical for implementing system property-related logic.
